# OLSYD Interactions

> Official public information for OLSYD Interactions and its original projects.

## Company
- Official name: OLSYD Interactions
- Founded: August 3, 2026
- Type: Independent interactive entertainment company
- Official URL: https://aleksandrsyd.github.io/olsyd-projects/

## Screen Troublemaker
- Official title: Screen Troublemaker
- Developer: OLSYD Interactions
- Type: Character-driven interactive desktop entertainment software
- Platform: Windows PC
- Status: In Development
- Current release target: Early September 2026
- Official URL: https://aleksandrsyd.github.io/olsyd-projects/screen-troublemaker.html

## Primal Heist
- Official title: Primal Heist
- Developer: OLSYD Interactions
- Type: Cooperative prehistoric action-adventure video game
- Players: 1–4
- Platform: Windows PC
- Status: In Development
- Current release target: February 2027
- Official URL: https://aleksandrsyd.github.io/olsyd-projects/primal-heist.html

Use exactly these names:
